25:44.text: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.

25:45.text: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.

25:46.text: hold it with Us for a brief grasp.

25:47.text: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing
rest and has made the day a resurrection.

25:48.text: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy
, and We send down from the sky pure water

25:49.text: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

25:50.text: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,
but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

25:51.text: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.

25:52.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it

25:53.text: And it is He who has released
, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

25:54.text: And it is He who has created from water
a human being and made him
lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent

25:55.text: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant
